title: Shattered Sun Reflection
description: A surreal mosaic painting split horizontally by a reflective waterline. The upper half shows a radiant golden sun exploding from a fractured red base, surrounded by a radiating halo of fragmented blue and multicolored shards against a vibrant pink and purple background. The lower half mirrors the scene in a watery reflection populated with green leaves, orange star-shaped flowers, and scattered mosaic pieces.
prompt: Surreal mosaic painting divided by a reflective water surface.
